scene: The attendant hands you three travel passes to different city districts.
picture: Along a flat stone platform, a yellow glass-roofed trolley sits on rails on the left. The player in lilac headscarf and mustard coat stands centre-left holding passes beside the attendant. In the centre rises an open spiral lift. On the right, a wooden river barge floats tied to a low dock.
shown: a yellow glass-roofed trolley stopped on rails on the left
a tall spiral lift with open lattice gates standing in the centre
